label: Job application
student_note: Move Education first when the candidate has under three years of full-time work.
lead_with: Production work: what shipped, who depended on it, what it moved.
noise: GPA once there is real work history
notes: A hiring manager is asking one question: has this person done the job before, or the nearest thing to it. Tenure, domain and outcome beat volume of side projects. Name the industry and the stakes, because 'built a web app' and 'built payment paths for a bank' read as different jobs.
summary_note: Two or three lines under the contact block, rewritten per posting. It is the highest-leverage sentence on the page and the most posting-sensitive: name the role being applied for in the reader's own words, then the single result that proves it.
